---
description: Review SpectraEvents architecture without inventing problems
---

Read the canonical architecture and ADRs. Inspect dependency direction, module placement, Paper
leakage, duplicated or event-specific abstractions, unnecessary dependencies, giant services,
hidden coupling, threading assumptions, blocking server-thread work, testability, and future adapter
compatibility. Classify each observation as a confirmed architectural problem, potential future
concern, intentional tradeoff, or false positive. Provide exact evidence and do not manufacture
findings.
